notes.title: 39,000 Wishlists... and a Development Update 2025/08!!
notes.notes: [p]Hey all! Melos from the team here. We made a recent devlog post- if you're interested, just search "Melos Han-Tani Substack" on google and read the latest post![/p][p]But I'll summarize a bit here.[/p][p]So, we are on good progress for releasing this year - likely still November or December![/p][p]We may only be releasing in English first with a localized version coming in following months, although at a minimum we are trying to have Simplified Chinese and Brazilian Portuguese available at launch. Our remaining target languages (Russian, Japanese, Korean, Spanish) will be done if we make enough money.[/p][p]One big milestone for us is finishing the overworlds. Angeline Era has a lot of levels - between 8-20 hours for a single playthrough depending how thorough you are. Here's a preview of one of the first overworld areas:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44231730/37a2d1d1c932a301f54ba481bf9ddda6ca3c5d2f.png"][/img][/p][p]Outside of that, I finished the music, a bunch of SFX, and some test playthroughs of the game for design/bugtesting/narrative reasons. Marina on the art side has finished a bunch of new area, NPC, and enemy art, as well as some final writing for the game. We're hoping the game has a unique approach to story and lore! You can enjoy the main storyline, or explore all the areas and imagine for yourself what the backstories to the world are.[/p][p]Other than that, we hit 39,000 total wishlists! Honestly I couldn't ask for much more. I'm just hoping we can have a smooth rest of development for now as I go into some closed Beta testing.[/p][p]Please look forward to Angeline Era later this year! We'll also be keeping the demo up through release - which will retain its multiple translations.[/p][p]Anyways, if you'd like to support us till release, consider sharing a trailer with your friend groups.[/p][list][*][p]Melos[/p][/*][/list]
